name: app-6ace91fc584c8191814a8daef4ed231c
description: Find projects, review jobsite photos and documents, and keep tasks, checklists, and estimates current in CompanyCam.

interface.longDescription: CompanyCam helps contractors find projects, review jobsite photos and documents, add comments and tasks, and keep customers, checklists, and estimates up to date through ChatGPT. It only accesses data available to your connected CompanyCam account.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest photos on my active project.
Add a task to the Johnson Kitchen Remodel project.

positive.description: Find a project by its name or jobsite address.
positive.prompt: Find the Smith Residence project on 123 Main Street.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching project with its name, jobsite address, and ID.

positive.description: List the photos on a project.
positive.prompt: Show me the most recent photos on the Smith Residence project.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns recent photos for the project with capture dates, descriptions, and links.

positive.description: Create a new project at a jobsite.
positive.prompt: Create a project called Johnson Kitchen Remodel at 456 Oak Avenue, Springfield, IL 62704.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project and returns its name, jobsite address, and ID.

positive.description: Post a comment on a project.
positive.prompt: Add a comment to the Smith Residence project saying the roof tear-off is finished.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the comment to the project and confirms it with the comment text and timestamp.

positive.description: Create a task on a project.
positive.prompt: Add a task called Order shingles to the Smith Residence project.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task on the project and returns its title and status.

negative.description: Do not trigger for weather requests.
negative.prompt: What is the weather forecast for my jobsite tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for permanent account deletion.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete my whole CompanyCam account and every project in it.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission addressing review feedback. Tool annotations and justifications now match each tool's behavior. Webhook tools no longer accept credentials or return signing tokens. Invoice payment-method toggles were removed. The OAuth consent screen discloses data use, and connectors are granted only the scopes they request.
